backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing comment list management with single/bulk comment generation, usage tracking, and access control via keys and roles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three high-confidence features related to fixing async handling, dropdown refresh, and error handling in AdminCommentsTab and useAdminComments.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and configuration for a comment generator app with admin features.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light/dark theme variables for UI components and sidebar.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx for the APP REVIEW application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with four routes (customer view, upload, live list, admin) and React Query client with theme provider.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminChatT: Admin UI component for managing chat messages with sender/message input form, send functionality, and message history display with timestamps.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminComme: Admin UI component for managing comment lists with creation, bulk/single comment upload, deletion, reset, and statistics display functionality.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminImage: Admin UI component for viewing and deleting uploaded rating images in a grid layout with uploader name and timestamp metadata.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLiveL: Admin UI component for managing live list apps and usernames with creation, bulk/comma-separated username upload, deletion, and reset functionality.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminSetti: Admin UI component for managing the bulk generator access key with set, reset, and masked key display functionality.
frontend/src/components/AdminTokenGate.t: Authorization guard component that checks admin token validity and displays access denied card if unauthorized or loading state while checking.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedBackdrop: Empty component file for canvas-based animated background (implementation truncated or removed).
Empty component file for glassmorphism audio player (implementation truncated or removed).
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Empty component file for authentication/authorization wrapper (implementation truncated or removed).
frontend/src/components/EffectBurst.tsx: Empty component file for visual effects like heart explosions and confetti (implementation truncated or removed).
frontend/src/components/GalleryGrid.tsx: Empty component file for responsive gallery grid (implementation truncated or removed).
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Empty component file for Internet Identity login/logout button (implementation truncated or removed).
frontend/src/components/Rotating3DObject: Component rendering a 3D rotating cube with six colored faces using CSS transforms.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Empty component file for footer with copyright and Caffeine.ai attribution (implementation truncated or removed).
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Root layout with fixed background image, TopSegmentedNav header, main content outlet, and footer with Caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/SiteNav.tsx: Empty component file for responsive navigation (implementation truncated or removed).
frontend/src/components/TeddyMascot.tsx: Empty component file for teddy bear mascot with animations (implementation truncated or removed).
Sticky navigation bar with segmented buttons for Customer View, Upload Section, Live List Checker, and conditionally-shown Admin Panel based on admin token.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializes admin access control, and invalidates dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminComments.ts: React Query hooks for admin comment list management including fetching available lists, creating lists, adding single comments, bulk uploading comments, and managing comment totals with proper error handling and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminToken.ts: Custom hook for admin authentication using a hardcoded token stored in session storage, checking URL hash parameters and providing admin access state.
frontend/src/hooks/useBulkGeneratorKey.t: React Query hooks for managing bulk generator API keys including checking key status, setting new keys, and resetting keys with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useChatMessages.ts: React Query hooks for fetching all chat messages and adding new chat messages with automatic query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: React Query hooks for comment generation features including fetching comment lists, generating single and bulk comments with device tracking, and checking bulk key status with comprehensive error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveListChecker.ts: React Query hooks for managing live list apps and checking usernames against them, including admin operations like adding apps, managing usernames, and resetting data.
frontend/src/hooks/useRatingImages.ts: React Query hooks for managing rating images including uploading, fetching all images, and deleting images by index with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes using OKLCH color space, utility classes for pastel backgrounds, cards, buttons, and 3D rotating cube animations.
frontend/src/lib/deviceId.ts: Provides utilities for generating and storing a stable device identifier in localStorage, and tracking which comment lists have been used for single-generation on the current device.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin panel page with tabbed interface for managing comments, images, chat, live lists, and settings with corresponding tab components.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerViewPage.tsx: Customer-facing page for generating single or bulk comments from selected lists, with device-based single-generation restrictions and admin access code entry.
frontend/src/pages/LiveListCheckerPage.t: Page for checking usernames against selected live list apps, with localStorage persistence for selections and results, and CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/pages/UploadSectionPage.tsx: Page for uploading rating images with uploader name, featuring progress tracking and success feedback using ExternalBlob for file handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup capabilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, container settings, border radius variables, and plugins for animations and typography.
project_state.json: Project state tracking a comment list management system with backend persistence issues. The main problem is that list creation gets stuck in loading state and newly created lists don't appear in the dropdown, requiring fixes to frontend async handling and backend Motoko canister methods.
